title: Western licensing deals for Chinese radioligand therapies to jump in 2027, Sleuth forecasts
snippet: Deals for Chinese radiopharmaceutical assets have been rare to date and there is a limited pool of potential Western buyers available, Sleuth said.

title: Novo’s plan to hit $23B in revenue by 2035 leaves investors wanting
snippet: Novo has “gone shopping” to fill pipeline gaps, with a focus on obesity and diabetes, plus an expansion in blood and endocrine disorders, liver diseases and cardiovascular conditions.

title: Telix buys ITM for $1.65B in ‘supercritical’ radiopharma M&A
snippet: Aside from its manufacturing and distribution footprint, ITM Isotope Technologies Munich will give Telix Pharmaceuticals the late-stage ITM-11, being developed for gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors. The asset was rejected by the FDA last month for manufacturing concerns.

title: Novo buys three early-stage obesity assets from Kallyope as investor pressure mounts
snippet: Investors and analysts have been hounding Novo to beef up its pipeline and advance new molecules as a majority of the company's sales stem from its semaglutide franchise.

title: Citing Replimune approval, experts say localized cancer meds could redefine care
snippet: Delivering therapeutics directly to tumors, as in the case of Replimune’s recently approved Tudriqev and Amgen’s Imlygic, holds advantages, especially when cancer is caught early, but challenges remain before the method becomes a mainstay in treatment.

title: Mikhail, Davis on board with regulatory framework tailored to rare disease therapies
snippet: Newly permanent CBER and CDER directors Karim Mikhail and Michael Davis are widely expected to continue the FDA’s efforts toward an adaptive framework for rare disease therapies. If approved by the Senate, will commissioner nominee Heidi Overton stay the course?

title: Beyond Random Integration: Transposase cell line development shortening timeline & boosting titers
snippet: As molecule complexity rises, advanced cell line development platforms are giving biopharma companies new tools to overcome expression challenges, improve stability and reach the clinic faster.
